iep.iepSummary:
**Learning Disability - Reading**

Emma qualifies for special education services under SLD classification. Primary area of need: decoding and reading fluency.

**Goals:**
- Increase reading fluency from 65 to 90 words per minute
- Improve decoding accuracy to 90%

**Services:**
- 30 min/day pull-out reading intervention
- Wilson Reading System instruction 3x/week
iep.accommodations:
**Classroom Accommodations:**
- Extended time (1.5x) on tests
- Preferential seating near teacher
- Audio versions of texts when available
- Reduced homework load (quality over quantity)
- Use of graphic organizers
